title: Signals Notebook vs LabVantage: Which Lab Platform Fits Your Team?
summary: Compare Signals Notebook vs LabVantage across ELN, LIMS, SDMS, integrations, compliance, pricing, and scalability to choose the right platform for your lab.
body_markdown:
## **TL;DR**


- Signals Notebook from Revvity Signals is a cloud-native ELN focused on experiment documentation, collaboration, chemistry workflows, inventory, and instrument data capture.
- LabVantage is a broader enterprise laboratory informatics platform combining LIMS, ELN, LES, SDMS, analytics, and extensive system integrations.
- Signals Notebook is more ELN-centered, while LabVantage is LIMS-centered and designed to manage wider operational, sample, execution, and regulated laboratory workflows.
- The right choice depends on whether your priority is flexible R&D documentation or an integrated enterprise laboratory operations platform.


When comparing **Signals Notebook vs LabVantage** , laboratories are evaluating platforms with significantly different scopes. Signals Notebook specializes in scientific documentation and collaborative R&D, while LabVantage extends across sample lifecycle management, ELN, laboratory execution, scientific data management, and enterprise integrations.


Understanding that distinction is more useful than comparing feature lists alone.


## **Signals Notebook vs LabVantage at a Glance**


### **What Is Signals Notebook?**


Signals Notebook is Revvity Signals' cloud-native electronic lab notebook for pharmaceutical, biotechnology, chemicals, materials, formulation, and other scientific R&D teams.


Current capabilities include:


- Experiment documentation and templates
- Native ChemDraw integration
- Real-time collaboration
- Scientific search
- Inventory and materials management
- Audit trails and electronic signatures
- Instrument data capture through Signals DLX
- Integration with broader Revvity Signals products


Revvity currently lists Signals Notebook Standard at **$1,425 per user annually** .


### **What Is LabVantage?**


LabVantage is an integrated laboratory informatics platform built around enterprise LIMS.


Its platform combines:


- Laboratory Information Management System
- Electronic Lab Notebook
- Laboratory Execution System
- Scientific Data Management System
- Sample and consumables management
- Instrument management
- Workflow automation
- Analytics and reporting
- Enterprise integrations


LabVantage's ELN operates within the same platform as its LIMS, LES, and SDMS, allowing research and operational records to share laboratory context.

## **Signals Notebook vs LabVantage Feature Comparison**


### **ELN and Scientific Documentation**


Signals Notebook is purpose-built around day-to-day scientific documentation. Researchers can create experiments using flexible templates, add multimedia and Office documents, collaborate with permissions, search experimental records, and use native ChemDraw functionality for chemistry workflows.


LabVantage ELN supports both structured and unstructured experimental information and can exchange sample requests, test results, metadata, and procedural information directly with LabVantage LIMS.


If experiment documentation needs to stay connected to samples and operational workflows, explore Scispot'selectronic lab notebook platform.


### **LIMS and Sample Lifecycle Management**


This is the clearest difference.


Signals Notebook is primarily an ELN. Revvity itself describes the product as complementary to LIMS platforms, with integrations allowing research records to connect with structured laboratory operations.


LabVantage provides native LIMS capabilities covering sample lifecycle management, consumables, stability, environmental monitoring, instrument management, barcode workflows, dashboards, approvals, and laboratory execution.


### **Instrument Integrations and Scientific Data**


Signals Notebook can automate instrument-data capture through Signals DLX, reducing manual transfer of analytical results into experiments. Revvity also supports APIs and integrations with scientific and enterprise applications.


LabVantage provides integrated SDMS plus RESTful web services and connectors for systems such as SAP and Waters Empower. Its platform can interface with ERP, MES, MRP, QMS, instruments, and other enterprise systems.


For labs where connectivity is central to the decision, Scispot's[laboratory integration platform](https://www.scispot.com/integrations) connects instruments, ELNs, LIMS, databases, and cloud applications.


If instrument integrations are becoming an IT project of their own, Scispot can automate data capture, transformation, and synchronization across your lab stack.


### **Compliance, AI, and Data Intelligence**


Signals Notebook provides audit trails, permission-controlled collaboration, electronic signatures, and validation documentation for regulated deployments. Signals One builds on the notebook foundation with semantic search, AI-assisted experiment suggestions, protocol optimization, and broader analytics.


LabVantage includes security, auditing, electronic signatures, data integrity controls, and compliance-oriented laboratory execution. Its broader platform now also includes analytics with AI-powered semantic integration and search.


Regulated laboratories should validate the exact configuration, validation package, SOPs, permissions, and intended use for either platform.


## **Which Platform Fits Different Types of Labs?**


### **Chemistry and Research Organizations**


Signals Notebook is particularly relevant for chemistry, medicinal chemistry, materials science, formulation, and multidisciplinary R&D teams that prioritize experiment capture, ChemDraw, collaboration, and research data reuse.


For another comparison, see Scispot's[Benchling vs Signals Notebook guide](https://www.scispot.com/blog/benchling-vs-signals-notebook) .


### **QC, Manufacturing, and Enterprise Labs**


LabVantage may fit organizations that need full sample lifecycle management, laboratory execution, SDMS, extensive integrations, quality-oriented workflows, and enterprise-wide informatics.


Scispot's[Benchling vs LabVantage comparison](https://www.scispot.com/blog/benchling-vs-labvantage) provides additional context on LabVantage's positioning.


### **Labs Comparing Total Platform Scope**


Signals Notebook Standard has published per-user pricing, but broader Signals products, integrations, validation services, and enterprise requirements can affect total cost. LabVantage's LIMS and ELN pages do not publish a standard list price, so buyers should request a complete proposal covering implementation, migration, integrations, validation, training, and administration.


Buyers should test real workflows rather than relying solely on feature matrices. Scispot's[2026 LIMS vendor comparison](https://www.scispot.com/blog/top-lims-vendors) provides a broader evaluation framework.
